about: Short paths said in videos (video engine Phase 0, Todd's go Oct 27, 2026, call 2: a major site change approved in chat). Each is a tiny page kept out of search and the sitemap that records the visit with the cookie-free Cloudflare tag and forwards to its page after 1 second, so visits from video are counted on the path alone. Agents test these only on the local build and never open the live page. Built by tools/make_site.py (write_short_paths).
